describe: The image shows a tall, narrow flame column that rises from the bottom of a vertical frame, with a bright orange-yellow core and wispy tongues. It winds up the frame, with a thin tail reaching toward the top-right, and has dark grey smoke wisps around the flame edges. Contrast is moderate to high in the orange flames. The surrounding mid-grey is probably a transparent area shown on grey, so the flame and smoke are the only objects.
